_comment: Local-dev default only. In production, settings (including ConnectionStrings__VlmsDatabase and GraphMail__ClientSecret) are supplied as environment variables from /etc/vlms/jobs.env via deploy/systemd/vlms-jobs.service's EnvironmentFile (adr/0005-hosting-pivot-self-hosted-vps-postgresql.md) — this file is not the production configuration source.

ConnectionStrings._comment: PostgreSQL (adr/0005-hosting-pivot-self-hosted-vps-postgresql.md). Local-dev default only, same status as the rest of this file per the top-level _comment above.

Safeguarding._comment: low-level-design.md calls the consent/DBS expiry warning window 'configurable'; 28 is the documented build-time default (ConsentExpiryJob.DefaultExpiryWarningWindowDays) — override here or via the equivalent environment variable (Safeguarding__ExpiryWarningWindowDays in /etc/vlms/jobs.env) without a recompile.

GraphMail._comment: Microsoft Graph sendMail as the shared mailbox noreply@varangians.co.uk (adr/0005 amendment, 12/10/2026; Infrastructure/Notifications/GraphEmailSender.cs). TenantId/ClientId/SenderAddress are identifiers, not secrets. ClientSecret is a secret: PLACEHOLDER here, the real value only in the server's environment file as GraphMail__ClientSecret (deploy/README.md).
